notes: Product line is a BiDi transceiver pair: SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX80D-4955 (Tx/Rx 1490nm/1550nm) and SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX80D-5549 (Tx/Rx 1550nm/1490nm). Extended operating temperature option -20°C to +85°C (-E). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 8 – 26dB. Dispersion penalty max 1dB. Transmitter output power, minimum input power, and overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload measured @ 1.25Gbps, BER≤1x10-12, PRBS 2^7-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). Transmit wavelength 1484–1491nm (4955) and 1544–1557nm (5549). Receiver wavelength range 1530–1580nm (4955) and 1470–1510nm (5549). Power consumption stated as < 1.0W worst case.
suggestions: Consider list types for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when C-temp and E-temp variants are on one datasheet. Power budget 8–26dB may warrant dedicated fields. Dispersion penalty max 1dB lacks paired penalized optical parameter for penalties array.
